rows.note: Georgian-source income of an individual entrepreneur with small business status, gross income up to GEL 500,000 (GEL 700,000 for wine and agro tourism).
rows.source_title: Tax Code of Georgia (English translation, consolidated version 15/10/2026 - 28/10/2026)
rows.label: Small business status: 1% of turnover

rows.note: from the month gross income exceeds GEL 500,000 (GEL 700,000 for wine and agro tourism) to the end of the year.
rows.source_title: Tax Code of Georgia (English translation, consolidated version 15/10/2026 - 28/10/2026)
rows.label: Small business status: 3% above GEL 500,000 of gross income

rows.note: Self-employed contributions, withholding on payments to freelancers and contractors, simplified regimes for small businesses, and expat and digital-nomad rules.
rows.source_title: Tax Code of Georgia (English translation, consolidated version 15/10/2026 - 28/10/2026)
rows.label: Fixed (flat) tax for activities set by the Government
rows.value: For activities set by the Government: GEL 1 to GEL 2,000 per object of taxation, or 3% of revenue

rows.note: income of a self-employed person who has joined the funded pension scheme.
rows.source_title: Law of Georgia on Funded Pension (English translation, consolidated version 26/06/2025 - 16/09/2026)
rows.label: Funded pension contribution of the self-employed (4% of income)

rows.note: payments for services to a natural person who is not registered as an individual entrepreneur (not VAT-registered, micro, small or fixed-tax business).
rows.source_title: Tax Code of Georgia (English translation, consolidated version 15/10/2026 - 28/10/2026)
rows.label: Withholding on payments for services to unregistered individuals (20%)

rows.note: salary of employees of an international company (status granted by the Government).
rows.source_title: Tax Code of Georgia (English translation, consolidated version 15/10/2026 - 28/10/2026)
rows.label: Employees of an international company: salary taxed at 5%

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.note: Under review: the general 0% for goods not listed is inferred from the structure of art. 197 and the exemptions of art. 199; not read as one sentence.
rows.source_title: Tax Code of Georgia (English translation, consolidated version 15/10/2026 - 28/10/2026)
rows.label: Import duty rates: 0%, 5% and 12% of the customs value
rows.value: Import duty is 0% on most goods; 12% or 5% of the customs value on the goods listed in art. 197 (mainly agricultural and food products and some construction materials)

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.source_title: Tax Code of Georgia (English translation, consolidated version 15/10/2026 - 28/10/2026)
rows.label: Traveller allowance by air: goods up to GEL 3,000 and 30 kg free of import duty

rows.label: Other travellers: goods up to GEL 500 and 30 kg once in 30 days
